survivorship.note: After a bond's last grid day its return is 0 (cash at CDI): losses up to the last trade are kept, anything after it (e.g. a default with no further prints) is unobserved.

design.decision_dates: first grid day of each month, 2022-01-03..2026-09-01
design.entry: first trade dated after decision day, >=1 bday later, within 20 bdays; otherwise the weight stays in cash (0 excess)
design.target: compounded rate-hedged excess return over CDI (patched daily chain incl. gap moves), from entry
